Rae (CSM): Quick kickoff for Cypress onboarding — 15m sync to confirm owners, acceptance criteria, and 30/60 plan. Proposed Wed 9:00 PT. Agenda: owners, data pre-reqs, early-value signals.
Omar (Cypress PO): Wed 9:00 PT works. Legal will join for a short retention/masking check. Also want a simple cost estimate for our main flow.
Tess (Solutions Eng): Need sanitized sample payload, schema, and expected peak qps. If >30 qps we should discuss reserved capacity.
Vik (Enablement): I'll prepare a 20-min follow-up demo + runbook (masking steps + KB links). Can record.
Rae (CSM): Draft 30d acceptance to verify in sync: staging ingest + two core flows validated; recorded demo + runbook delivered; dashboard with three renewal signals (flow usage, ingest error rate, time-to-first-successful-inference).
Omar (Cypress PO): Agreed. We'll send sample data by EOD Monday.
Tess (Solutions Eng): Quick staging snippet I'll use once keys are live: ```bash
export RW_API_KEY=stg-cypress-xxx
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
OnboardingBot: Calendar event created: "Cypress onboarding intake" Wed 09:00 PT. Invitees: Rae, Omar, Tess, Vik.
Rae (CSM): I'll post a 1-pager with pre-reqs 2 hours before and include owners + mitigation for risks (data delay, quota surprises, compliance signoff). Cheers.
